Product · AI Component Library

The AI patterns your design system does not have yet.

Prompt inputs, streaming responses, suggestion cards, confidence and sources, agent activity, approval gates. Every team building AI features designs these from scratch and gets them slightly wrong. This library gives you a tested set that takes on your existing tokens, so it drops into the system you already have.

Things people usually ask.

Does this replace our design system?

No. It adds the AI layer your system is missing, and borrows its look from your existing tokens.

What about Angular, Vue or Web Components?

React ships first. The Figma library, tokens and specifications work with any framework, and Enterprise integration can include porting to your stack.

Are the components accessible?

They are built to WCAG 2.2 AA, with particular care for the things AI interfaces usually get wrong: announcing streamed text, focus during agent actions, and keyboard reachable controls.
